description: A Python script that lists source files of an installed module by parsing a ninja build manifest and collecting transitive dependencies.

methods.name: _parse_args
methods.description: Parses command line arguments for input file, filters, and output directory options.

methods.name: collect_source_files
methods.description: Collects transitive dependencies of a build target, filtering out binaries, shared libraries, and certain directories.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that loads the build manifest, constructs a graph, filters files, and outputs source dependencies.
